The '''Barbeen system''' was a part of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the social group known as the [[Brothers of Barbeen]].<ref name="JP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Barbeen [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
